tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search the 6,010 Jiggicons by words (e.g. "bell", "arrow left", "shopping cart"). Returns icon ids, names, categories and whether each is free.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The Jiggicons categories with how many icons each has.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: The source of one icon, ready to save into the project: a React or Vue component, JS/TS data, JSON, or a plain SVG of one variant. Paid icons need the licence key the server was configured with.
